mapper.update: UPDATE idempotent_record SET locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, request_hash = #{requestHash}, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE idempotent_key = #{key} AND status = 0 AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < NOW(3))
UPDATE idempotent_record SET status = 2, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, locked_until = NULL WHERE status = 0 AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < #{deadline}) LIMIT #{limit}
UPDATE idempotent_record SET status = 1, result_snapshot = #{snapshot}, error_msg = NULL, locked_until = NULL WHERE idempotent_key = #{key} AND status = 0
UPDATE idempotent_record SET status = 2, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, locked_until = NULL WHERE idempotent_key = #{key} AND status = 0
UPDATE idempotent_record SET status = 0, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, error_msg = NULL WHERE idempotent_key = #{key} AND status = 2 AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > NOW(3))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM idempotent_record WHERE expire_time IS NOT NULL AND expire_time < NOW(3) LIMIT #{limit}
